Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.24.5
Mosaic Master rebuilt with a new window, sky map, seam quality panel map, Advanced panel matching and a fast plate-solve based Robotic Mosaic mode for Seestar and DWARF frames, plus the black dot fix (GitHub 138). It also adds a Workflow Assistant Graph View, linear Live Stacking with SNR goals and worker processes, before and after comparison in Convolution and Multiscale Decomposition, and Stacking Suite fixes for colour lights, CFA drizzle, drop shrink and Canon CR3 files.
